scope: Shared NFS low-nine-bit mode and simple NFSv4 ACL increment. Full SMB/NFS is not complete.

checks: NFSv3 mode is enforced, owner/group are mapped, nonowner chmod denied; NFSv4 advertises real ACL support
group mode checks use only verified AUTH_SYS groups; omitted groups and root-squashed groups cannot grant access
ACL+mode applies mode then ACL; named-user ACE roundtrips, READ_ACL is enforced and chmod masks named grants
invalid ACL principal and flags fail before truncation; empty ACL denies data and owner can recover WRITE_ACL
special/named groups and primary-group changes enforce the mapped trustee; opaque SMB SIDs roundtrip; execute-only NFS READ/OPEN/ACCESS works; invalid CREATE ACL leaves no object
directory ACL inheritance preserves OWNER@ and clears the acl-only inherited flag; ACL attributes larger than 4 KiB roundtrip
NFS chmod and ACL changes govern new SMB opens of the same object
shared ACLs, symbolic principals and derived mode survive complete service restart
schema 5 migration backs up each file authority before adding persistent security descriptors
self-relative owner/group/DACL query, requested sections, required buffer size and READ_CONTROL/WRITE_DAC/SACL boundaries
ordered deny/allow access checks, MAXIMUM_ALLOWED and explicit-right intersection; existing handles retain granted rights
SMB denial enforced by NFSv3 READ/ACCESS, NFSv4 ACCESS, core API and WebDAV readonly aliases
ACE order, empty versus NULL DACL, implicit owner rights and OWNER RIGHTS SID
malformed offsets, overlaps, truncation and unsupported ACEs rejected atomically; ownership cannot be assigned to another user
file/directory inheritance with CREATOR OWNER substitution and multi-generation propagation; ACL follows rename
SecD CREATE persists protected initial ACL, validates ownership and rejects duplicate/malformed contexts before mutation
group ACE enforcement and membership revocation use freshly signed identity grants
schema 6 durability across process restart; replacement object receives fresh owner and ACL
NFS writer publication still enforces file DACL; WRITE and chmod cannot bypass SMB restrictions
DAV writer cannot bypass ACL; staged PUT retains restrictions, recursive COPY checks descendants and inherits destination ACL through private staging parents
DAV LOCK on unmapped URL checks parent create rights and persists inherited DACL
TCP record fragmentation and MOUNT v3 with independent XDR codecs
unknown UID/GID/groups rejected; root squashed to explicitly unprivileged subject
root squash uses anonymous read rights, strips privileged groups and rejects writes/revoked rights
read-only TCP portmapper advertises NFS and does not advertise unsupported NLM version 3
trailing XDR rejected before WRITE; previously persisted bytes remain intact
v3 guarded CREATE, 64 KiB UNSTABLE upgraded to FILE_SYNC, READ, COMMIT, exact duplicate WRITE
MAC tamper rejected; file handle survives external rename and all-service restart; durable v3 replay and new write verifier
deleted/recreated path cannot revive an old file handle
v3 MKDIR, cross-directory RENAME, READDIRPLUS, REMOVE/RMDIR type separation
pynfs v4.1 EXCHANGE_ID/CREATE_SESSION/SEQUENCE, guarded OPEN, WRITE/READ, exact slot replay
false slot replay and foreign stateid rejected; GETATTR subset independently decoded
old sessions/stateids invalidated on reboot; persisted owner can reclaim OPEN during grace; CLOSE releases recovery record
unrelated client cannot reclaim another owner after restart
export disable revokes existing handles through fresh identity grants
offline metadata backup strips NFS enrollment and excludes persistent capability/recovery databases
v3 CREATE preserves mode, mapped ownership and explicit atime/mtime on native handles
v3 ctime differs from preserved mtime and advances for mode-only metadata changes across export aliases
v4 SETATTR updates aliases consistently; GETATTR rejects write-only time attributes
durable change counters detect equal-size writes with restored mtime, share alias state and return real namespace change_info; reads do not advance them
v3 used and v4 space_used match independent native allocation for empty, small, sparse/extended and truncated files, separately from logical size
paged v4 READDIR skips reserved cookies 1/2 and resumes without duplicate or missing entries
mode/ownership and exact timestamps survive server restart through stable alias handles

checks: NFSv3 MKDIR accepts zero size hints without attempting to truncate a directory
required suppattr_exclcreat advertises actual writable creation attributes
exclusive verifier retry preserves content; mismatched verifier and unsupported exclusive attributes reject without creation
UNCHECKED ignores nonzero size and mode on existing files; zero size truncates only after share reservations permit it
CREATE and OPEN return the attributes actually applied

preceding_regression.resolution: M1–M6 passed, including 1649 SMB core assertions and full litmus. M7 core mock grant lacked UID/GID mappings; the fixture now matches real signed grants. Final 68-check core and 15-group M7 integration pass above. This partial runner is not claimed as a full M1–M7 pass.

upstream_pynfs.source_note: 145 selected cases passed before final ACL flag normalization and fixture update; 121 unselected cases remain visible. Remote full suite reruns the fixed source.

diagnostics.problem: GID aliases mapped to same service group returned the first alias instead of the requested one
diagnostics.resolution: Preserve the stored numeric alias only while its export mapping matches the descriptor; attributes regression passes.

diagnostics.problem: Inheritance denial test granted execute while expecting NFS read rejection
diagnostics.resolution: RFC 8881 permits NFS execute-authorized reads; denial now covers both READ_DATA and EXECUTE and a separate execute-only READ/OPEN/ACCESS test passes.

diagnostics.problem: Optional local Samba regression initially could not find smbtorture in PATH
diagnostics.resolution: Reran with the existing .deps/native-client binary and extracted libraries; all 13 selected ACL cases passed.
